We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards. This is a 6-month full-time onsite internship (Jan - June 2027). HackerRank is looking for high-potential Hacker Interns to join our team of world-class full-time Hackers as we build the most engaged community of Developers. If this sounds exciting, read on... Each one of you will be paired with a mentor, who will support you throughout your internship. Whether you're graduating and seeking a full-time position after your internship, or hoping to return for another internship next year, you'll be considered for a returning offer during your internship. f92ffb6c77f2.title: Product Management Intern
f92ffb6c77f2.description: Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience About the Team & Role The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges. The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable. We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection. What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter) Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities. Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams. Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity. Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility. Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap. What You’ll Need Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28 Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus. Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage. Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements. Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders. Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model). What You’ll Gain True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project. High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership. Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. dae372dcefd0.title: Product  Ops Intern
dae372dcefd0.description:
WHO ARE WE?

At Composio, we are building infrastructure that allows agents to communicate with the tools you use for work including Github, Gmail, Notion, Salesforce, etc. We are a small team of engineers wrangling problems from context to search, that help us provide the most capable bridge between your agents and your tools.

We raised a $25M Series A from Lightspeed https://lsvp.com/stories/investing-in-composio-building-the-backbone-of-ai-agent-intelligence/ with some incredible angels like Guillermo Rauch (CEO of Vercel), Dharmesh Shah (CTO of Hubspot), Gokul Rajaram. Beginning of this year we 3x our ARR, our customer range from your friends in the YC batch to Wabi, Glean, Zoom and many more.



WHAT WILL YOU DO?

Building Agents

 - Write down the manual playbook as you run it, then work out what a person should never have to touch again

 - Build AI agents that watch inboxes, send the follow-ups, and keep the tracker current on their own

 - Turn repetitive outreach and tracking into workflows that keep running without you in the loop

 - Multiply yourself, so one person can keep hundreds of apps moving at once without anything slipping
   
   Operations

 - Shepherd new app connectors from first request to live: securing OAuth approvals and API access, spinning up sandbox credentials and test accounts, and clearing whatever verification or paperwork stands in the way

 - Hold hundreds of apps in view at once, each parked at a different stage of approval

 - Chase approvals until they actually land, not until the first email goes unanswered

 - Make the demo videos and scope-mapping docs that move partners from maybe to yes

 - Own the status of every app, so engineering, product, and partners never have to ask where things stand
   
   
   


WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

 - You already build with AI every day. It's part of how you work, not a box you'd tick out of curiosity

 - You stay with a problem until it's actually solved, sending the fifth follow-up long after most people quit at the first

 - You can keep fifty-plus threads in motion at once without letting one slip through

 - You work well without a map: you find the real problem before anyone hands it to you, then go fix it

 - Your first instinct is to automate a task rather than do it a second time

 - Automation, agents, workflows, and  operations are the tools you use to hit a goal, not the job itself. We want someone who cares about achieving the goal, not a "whatever it takes" task executor
   

On the practical side:

 - An engineering background — BTech, CS, or similar — ideally with a few projects you've actually built and shipped

 - Writing clean enough to land in a partner's or customer's inbox without a second draft

 - Able to be in Bengaluru, in person, for the full 2 months (we are willing to extend the internship tenure to 6 months if more projects come in)

 - Final-year students and recent grads equally welcome, including if you're holding a full-time offer that starts later in the year
